packs.name: Kenney Building Kit
packs.license_evidence_url: https://kenney.nl/assets/building-kit (page states 'Creative Commons CC0'; License.txt inside zip: 'License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0)')
animations: open-and-close (on every door-rotate-*.glb; nodes 'door' and 'handle' are separate so the door can also be posed by rotating the 'door' node)
packs.notes: PRIMARY ROOM SHELL. Grid-modular walls, half/low walls, doorways, windows, floor tiles, columns, wall plating and pipes. The eight door-rotate-* GLBs are hinged doors with baked open/close clips, which satisfies the 'door that can be posed open' requirement. Single 'colormap' material with one texture per GLB (Models/Textures/variation-a.png) so a dark concrete look is one texture swap or material override. Flat/plain wall style reads as concrete-industrial from an isometric camera.

packs.name: Kenney Retro Urban Kit
packs.license_evidence_url: https://kenney.nl/assets/retro-urban-kit (page: 'Creative Commons CC0'; License.txt in zip: 'License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0)')
packs.notes: GRITTY WALL SET. The wall-a/wall-b families are concrete-and-brick warehouse walls (plain, painted, window, garage door, broken) that match the converted-warehouse brief better than anything else found. Separate materials per GLB ('concrete', 'wall_lines', 'metal', 'windows') with per-material PNGs embedded, so concrete and brick tints can be overridden independently. Also gives exterior cables, beams, scaffolding, dumpster, damaged asphalt and loose doors (door-type-a/b are standalone meshes you can pivot yourself; no baked animation).

packs.name: Kenney Modular Buildings
packs.notes: Facade tiles for the buildings seen THROUGH the windows: stackable window/door/block wall units plus flat roofs, rooftop AC boxes and standalone door/window inserts. Single 'colormap' material. Brownstone-ish flavour; darken the texture for a night city.

packs.name: Kenney City Kit (Commercial)
packs.notes: OUTSIDE-THE-WINDOW SKYLINE. Five skyscrapers plus 14 low-detail block buildings (cheap silhouettes, ~100 KB each) for the dark city backdrop. Single 'colormap' material with two texture variations (Models/Textures/variation-a.png, variation-b.png).

packs.name: Kenney City Kit (Industrial)
packs.notes: Warehouses, factories, chimneys, tanks, a water tower and shipping containers for the rooftop/industrial view outside. 20 whole-building GLBs. Materials 'colormap' + 'colormap-specular'; three texture variations. Skip the solar-panel and windmill files for this theme.

packs.name: Kenney City Kit (Roads)
packs.license_evidence_url: https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-roads (page: 'Creative Commons CC0'; License.txt in zip)
packs.notes: Street level for the block outside: road tiles, power poles and sagging wires (great for the tangled-cable silhouette against the windows), street lights, hanging traffic lights, a dumpster and construction fencing. Single 'colormap' material. Least essential pack in the lane; drop it first if space matters.

packs.name: Quaternius Cyberpunk Game Kit (GLB bundle via poly.pizza)
packs.license_evidence_url: https://poly.pizza/bundle/Cyberpunk-Game-Kit-Hkfxa8K8zF (every model listed 'CC0 1.0', bundle marked Public Domain) and https://quaternius.com/packs/cyberpunkgamekit.html (CC0; links creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0)
animations: (robot enemies only, not needed) CharacterArmature|Idle, Walk, Run, Attack, Shoot, Death/Dead, Jump
packs.notes: ROOFTOP / NEON DRESSING. 'Cyberpunk Signs.glb' is 13 separate neon-sign meshes in one file (Texture_Signs material) - the neon-sign source for both outside the windows and the den. Also AC units, stacked AC, antennas, a TV tower, cables, pipes, rails and supports for a Mr.-Robot rooftop skyline, plus a sliding-style Door.glb (static mesh, orange/grey/screen materials). Materials are named flat colours (Black, Grey, LightGrey, Orange, Screen, Light) so brand recolours are trivial. Files with a hash suffix (e.g. 'Streetlight-Wp6Eh4r9VX.glb') are alternate variants. Robot/turret/pickup files are off-theme and can be ignored or deleted.

packs.name: KayKit Dungeon Pack 1.1 (free tier)
packs.license_evidence_url: https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-dungeon-pack (page: 'Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal'); License.txt inside download: 'License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0)'
packs.notes: ALTERNATE STONE/BASEMENT SHELL. Chunky stone-block walls, cracked and broken variants, doorways, open/closed windows, stone and grate floor tiles, wood floors, a ceiling tile, columns and rubble - useful if the den reads better as a brick cellar than a concrete box. All models share one 'texture' material on a single 1024 gradient atlas (dungeon_texture.png), so a cooler/darker recolour is one PNG edit; note the .gltf files reference 'dungeon_texture.png' relative to Assets/gltf/, so keep that copy beside them. No hinged door piece in the free tier (wall_doorway is an opening only); banners, chests, coins and other medieval props are off-theme. Trimmed after download: the redundant obj/ and fbx(unity)/ folders were deleted to get the pack from 52 MB to 36 MB; gltf/ and fbx/ are intact.

rejected: Quaternius Modular Sci-Fi MegaKit (quaternius.itch.io/modular-sci-fi-megakit, CC0): has walls/doors/floors but the clean white sci-fi corridor look is wrong for a grimy warehouse, and the 46 MB free zip would push the lane past the ~120 MB budget once unpacked.
Quaternius Ultimate Modular Cyberpunk: no such pack exists on quaternius.com (page 404s; searches only return the Cyberpunk Game Kit, which was taken instead).

Quaternius Cyberpunk Game Kit from quaternius.com directly: the site's download button only opens a Google Drive folder (not curl-friendly), so the identical CC0 GLB bundle was pulled from poly.pizza's bundle API instead.
Kenney City Kit (Suburban) (CC0): detached houses and lawns - suburban, explicitly not the look.
KayKit City Builder Bits (CC0, 4.6 MB): cute pastel isometric toy-town buildings; too cheerful for a dark rain-streaked city and duplicates the Kenney city kits.
KayKit Dungeon Pack Extra/Source tiers and Quaternius Sci-Fi Pro/Source tiers: paid, so not downloaded (and Source tiers include non-CC0 tooling).
Eclair Assets 'City Roads GLB Pack' on itch.io: claims CC0 but is a third-party repackage of Kenney's roads; the original Kenney pack was taken instead so the license trail is first-party.
